verdict.rationale: Fellow explicitly documents configurable retention policies including zero-day retention (fellow-docs-28) and organization-wide policies for how meetings are recorded, accessed, and retained (fellow-docs-12, fellow-docs-54), plus a Super Admin API that lets Enterprise admins retrieve, export, and delete data across the entire workspace for legal/regulatory erasure (fellow-docs-14, fellow-docs-47). Missing for 10: no detail on how retention schedules are configured in the admin UI (e.g., granularity, automation confirmation) and no independent/hands-on verification of on-demand deletion actually purging data.
